name: Coffee Pub Crier
tagline: Combat narrated through rich turn cards and sounds.
description: Posts chat cards for combat start, each round, each turn and combat end, with portraits, blood splatter as damage builds, and configurable visibility of health and conditions. Downed characters can roll death saves from the card.
pitch: Turn every combat into a story, with chat cards for each round and turn showing health, conditions and death saves, and portraits that gain blood splatter as heroes take damage.

features.title: Combat announcements
features.text: Chat cards for combat start, each round, each combatant's turn, and combat end.

features.title: Damage-aware portraits
features.text: Combatant portrait or token art gains blood splatter as damage is taken.

features.title: Configurable card details
features.text: Health, ability scores, status, conditions and turn penalties; choose who sees each: nobody, players, monsters, or everyone.

features.title: Death saves on the card
features.text: The owner of a downed character rolls the death save from the card; pips update for everyone.

features.title: Initiative-safe timing
features.text: Cards wait until initiative settles, so they never name the wrong combatant.

features.title: GM aids and secrecy
features.text: Whispers the GM when a turn seems missed, and can hide monster names from players.

steps: Install Coffee Pub Blacksmith 14.1.0 or later and Crier, then enable both.
Start combat: cards begin once everyone has rolled initiative, and nothing changes outside combat.
Tune clutter and sound under Configure Settings, Module Settings, Crier.

gallery.title: A character on the ground
gallery.text: At zero hit points the health bar gives way to death save pips, filled in as successes and failures are rolled. The owner of the character can roll the save right from the card, and the blood on the portrait gets heavier with the damage taken.
gallery.caption: Death save turn card

gallery.title: The compact card
gallery.text: The small layout folds portrait, class, walking speed and health bar into one row, with ability scores and active conditions below. Penalties such as -3 to ability checks are totaled at the bottom. It is the same card in less height.
gallery.caption: Compact turn card

gallery.title: Combat and round cards
gallery.text: Combat Begins and Round 1 post as their own cards, in different colors so they stand out when you scroll back through chat. Nothing posts until everyone has rolled initiative, so the order is settled first.
gallery.caption: Combat start and round cards

gallery.title: Monsters, kept vague
gallery.text: A monster's card can show its portrait and what its conditions cost it, such as -3 to attack rolls and -1 to AC, without a health bar or ability scores. The table gets what it needs to play the fight and no hit point count.
gallery.caption: NPC turn card

gallery.title: When a character dies
gallery.text: If the death saves go wrong, the pips are replaced by a band naming the character as dead, with a skull over the blood-covered portrait. The card updates in place on every screen, so nobody has to repost anything.
gallery.caption: Downed character card

gallery.title: Choose who sees what
gallery.text: Each block of the turn card has its own setting: portrait, health, ability scores, conditions and turn penalties. For each one, pick nobody, players, monsters or everyone. Monster names can be hidden from players as well.
gallery.caption: Turn card content settings
